---
title: "Orphan requirements"
---

Both requirements below are well-formed: correct types, valid statuses, no
structural findings. They are also connected to nothing -- no parent need,
no decision, no implementation, no test. REQ014 makes that visible as info
findings instead of letting the gaps stay invisible.

::: {.need #REQ-010 type="functional-requirement" status="draft"}
## Untraced logging requirement

Nothing derives from a stakeholder need; nothing implements or verifies it.
:::

::: {.need #REQ-011 type="functional-requirement" status="draft"}
## Untraced retention requirement

Same story: a floating obligation with no edges in either direction.
:::
